column1: # 1.21.1 -> 26.1 renames, applied by scripts/port/gen.py to the generated source tree.
# Format: `old<TAB>new`. Whole-word replacement, string literals included.
# The 26.1 rows are cumulative on top of the 1.21.11 ones: 26.1 is the first unobfuscated release,
# so there is no Yarn mapping to diff against any more and every row has to come from a compile
# error. Keeping the 1.21.11 block below means a rename that landed in 1.21.9 still applies.
# Rows with a package path come first (the generator sorts longest-first).
# Derived from the Loom mappings of both versions, joined on the intermediary name, and filtered to
# the names this source tree actually uses. Regenerate the candidate list with scripts/port/candidates.py if a
# future error looks like a rename that is missing here.
# The GUI render layer was renamed to the "extract" model: a screen no longer draws, it extracts a
# render state, and the whole drawing surface moved to GuiGraphicsExtractor with shorter names.
# The two phrase rows are what makes that a table entry instead of a 33-file edit; they must be
# longer than the bare type row below, which the generator's longest-first ordering guarantees.
# Every row here is qualified by its receiver or by the call that produced it: the bare names are
# generic enough that a future caller could mean something else entirely.
# The declared version ranges have to be rewritten too: `~1.21.1` means "below 1.22", which 26.1
# falls outside, so both loaders refuse to load the mod before any class runs. Each pattern is
# anchored on word characters at both ends, which is what the generator's whole-word match needs.
